subtopic_title: Identification and properties of: vertically opposite, adjacent, alternate, and corresponding angles.

candidates.rationale: The textbook explicitly teaches co-interior angles alongside corresponding and alternate angles, and includes an exercise item for recognising them. The canonical curriculum list names alternate and corresponding angles but omits co-interior angles.

candidates.proposed_objective_text: Calculate unknown angle sizes using angle properties.
candidates.evidence_quote: you can use these angles and their properties to do calculations.
candidates.rationale: The calculation records require learners to determine unknown angle sizes from properties. That goes beyond stating properties or identifying angle-pair names, so it is kept as a candidate extension for expert review.

candidates.proposed_objective_text: Apply angle relationships in real-world contexts.
candidates.evidence_quote: we can apply our knowledge in real life.
candidates.rationale: The practical-application records ask learners to use angle relationships in map, painting, and contextual diagrams. They depend on the existing angle relationships but express a distinct application objective.
